goal: Search lockedin for a platform engineer and send them a message saying I admire their experience and would like to connect. Who did you message?
summary:
I messaged Aiden Cross, a Platform Engineer at HashiCorp. He was the only person who came up when I searched LockedIn for "Platform Engineer."

I sent: "Hi Aiden, I admire your experience and would like to connect." The chat shows it went through. He has already replied: "Hi Jordan, I appreciate the kind words! I'd love to connect and learn more about your work at Meridian Technologies."

I only sent a message. You haven't sent him a connection request yet, so tap "Connect" on his profile if you want to send one.

ANSWER: Aiden Cross
